steps.content: [Hot Spring Inn - Screen Dims]
Your consciousness begins to reform from chaos, as if being retrieved from the depths of the ocean by a pair of small, delicate hands.
Your sense of touch returns first. A warm, viscous substance envelops your body, trapping you slightly. It clings to your limbs from all directions, compressing and drying against your skin.
Faint whispers seep into your mind, as if chanting something. The tone remains monotonous and steady, repeating unsettling phrases.

steps.speaker: Rumina
steps.content: Stir... with heat...

steps.speaker: Rumina
steps.content: Wash away the shadows... Become a nice little candle...
[Hot Spring Inn Normal], Heartbeat Sound
You jolt awake. Just moments ago, you were racing some "ghost" on the road to town, then you passed out from the sudden scare. What happened to you?
You check your body and arms. Everything seems intact with no injuries. The only strange thing is a triangular mark on the back of your hand. Did you scratch it somewhere?
Looking around, you see the familiar candelabras and hot spring, and smell the familiar aroma of incense. Your nerves begin to relax. At least here, you're safe.
[Insert Hourglass Effect]-First Time
Before passing out, you remember seeing a massive golden hourglass that seemed to possess some mysterious power. And there was that long-haired figure...
And that contemptuous chuckle. This must be the Witch mentioned in the story. It seems you've reached the core plot of this script.
But how did they manage to make it so convincing? It's almost too realistic.
You wonder how Prima is doing... when suddenly your thoughts are interrupted by a heavy slap on your shoulder.

steps.speaker: Eleanor
steps.content: Oh, hey there! Did you just get a Game Over too?
The unexpected slap startles you slightly, and your train of thought is abruptly interrupted.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>Game Over</color>?

steps.speaker: Eleanor
steps.content: I read in the guides that they use sleeping spray and hypnosis to make restarts feel ultra-realistic. There were even rumors about there being <color=#fb9259>Sinners</color>! But those posts got deleted right away. Welp, that must be fake anyway, or this place would've been shut down ages ago.

steps.speaker: Eleanor
steps.content: Wow, too bad I missed the whole thing... I just saw you bubbling up from the pool! That was hilarious!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Sleeping spray? Hypnosis?
In other words, you didn't actually faint earlier. Your character "died" and you were put to sleep and hauled back by the staff.
Just like in a game, you can restart after dying. The hot spring inn serves as both your starting point and respawn point.

You're still quite baffled. What method do they actually use to achieve that? Could it be harmful? But for now, you've accepted Eleanor's explanation. That comment about <color=#fb9259>Sinners</color> though... You should definitely keep an eye out for that.
You relax and lean back slightly, when something suddenly gets knocked over and tumbles down from the table.
[Insert CG - You're Awake - Surprised Candle Person]

steps.speaker: Rumina
steps.content: Please be careful... Each one takes quite a lot of effort to make.

Rumina pads over to your tiny wax figurine and bends down to pick it up, carefully brushing off the dust. Her tone is casual, as if she were just discussing the weather with you. She cradles the wax figurine in her hands before passing it to you.
What a fine little thing. You can't help but poke at the little wax figurine again, with its gaping mouth and bewildered expression.
Was this really your expression right before your "death"? You reach up to touch your own face.
You suddenly recall that unusual stiffness you felt upon waking. Does it mean... that after each "death," your dying expression will be preserved here, turned into a wax figurine by Rumina?
They might even sell it at the gift shop when you exit the game.
That would be mortifying, but the idea makes you chuckle anyway.
What concerns you most right now is the mysterious figure you saw at the end. Would Rumina answer if you asked her directly? You decide to test the waters.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Rumina, is there an NPC here with long purple hair who wears a black fitted dress?
Rumina opens her mouth, but no sound comes out. She just stands there silently, like a motionless doll.

Seon turns to Rumina, then back to you. A wisp of smoke leaking from its wick, it seems frustrated for not being able to take any side. Seeming deflated, it rests its five fingers on Rumina's hand, deciding to stay out of it.
But someone else chimes in excitedly.

steps.speaker: Eleanor
steps.content: I know, I know! You must have found an Easter egg! They're quite common in this kind of game! Aw, you're so lucky!
Eleanor eagerly squeezes her way in, breaking the awkward silence that has settled between you.
Rumina seems to breathe a small sigh of relief as she silently retreats into the shadows. Seon climbs up her arm to her shoulder, hopping and waving goodbye to you joyfully.
But you're not about to let her walk away that easily. You still need to confirm some information.
